personality_one_liner: An offline AR navigation HUD designed for instant return-to-start guidance in extreme environments with tactical amber accents.

spacing.rule: Generous and operational spacing hierarchy optimized for glanceability during movement

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom HUD controls over AR camera viewfinder
Apply translucent tinted base ≥75% opacity in dark mode
dont's: Never blur body text or interactive control inputs
Never allow background imagery to compromise metric readability

screens.name: ARNavigationHome
screens.purpose: Main AR navigation heads-up display with camera placeholder, recording toggle, AR mode switcher, and directional assist arrow.

states.loading: Calibrating spatial sensors and GPS beacons...
states.empty: No active return route recorded. Tap Start Recording to begin tracking.
states.error: GPS signal lost. Falling back to offline compass heading.

screens.layout: Full-screen dark AR viewfinder base layer with absolute positioned top status HUD, floating central directional assist arrow, dynamic AR display mode switcher (Dots / Arrows / Pin), and a sticky bottom control panel with the primary Start/Stop recording action and telemetry summary.

ar_viewfinder_bg.alt: Cinematic night forest drone light beam radar background

instructions_to_main_agent: Build MULEH mobile app using React Native / Expo following Personality 7 Dark-First Utility DARK.

Ensure the first frontend screen is the AR Navigation Home screen featuring a camera placeholder view, start/stop recording action, AR display mode switcher (dots, arrows, start pin), and a prominent directional assist arrow.
Apply high-contrast operational styling with tactical amber accent (#FF6B00) and deep obsidian surfaces (#121417).
Implement glassmorphic top HUD and bottom control container over the AR camera preview with required opacity and readability scrims.
Ensure all tap targets are ≥44x44pt and follow safe area guidelines.
